additional_reviewed_pages.summary: Explicitly restricted to System and Linear simulation. Documents PORT, source impedance R, source average carrier power and source phase reference. Supports using the same flat DUT design for both analyses without a hierarchy wrapper.
Local starting index for script verbs, object creation, external COM, Python and read-only external Python API.

Documents Analysis SetDataName/GetDataName/ClearModelCache/RunAnalysis; Item enumeration/property methods; parameter Get/Set and MKS GetValue; Dataset ExportS; workspace IsAnalysisDone/SaveAs. Manager.Update runs pending analyses and is not a read-only polling call.
Set uses the parameter display unit. This forbids guessing Hz from a numeric string without reading the existing unit and evaluated GetValue.

COM automation uses the shared GENESYS name and Interop.GENESYS.dll; C#/C++/VB are supported. Existing-instance/version verification matters. Registration changes are not needed for this read-only review.
Documents external workspace read access through keysight.systemvue; built for Python 3.10.6 and requires Python 3.10.x. No package was installed or imported here.

Variable.value is MKS and supports scalars and one-dimensional numpy arrays including complex values, but not matrices. units and indeps expose metadata; dataframe and slice_data are documented. Do not select .value as a complete multidimensional S exporter.
Dataset.variables maps names to Variable objects. export_data supports JSON with per-variable unit options; format and preservation of multidimensional S need a local preflight before reliance.
Workspace exposes datasets by name; external Analysis wrappers support only Sweeps and Data Flow. Thus this is an optional postprocessing reader, not a replacement RF/Linear analysis controller.
Points to COM plus built-in VB scripting and the local Users Guide Scripts section.
Documents the installed VBBrowser source/executable, object and method discovery, and RunAnalysis. The browser may launch the app when no instance exists, so it was not started.
Linear subcircuits can be characterized by the linear simulator for Spectrasys; avoiding an unnecessary hierarchy wrapper preserves the MID node for this acyclic flat RES chain.

concrete_parameter_candidates.path_route_candidate: Source,R1,R2,Port_2 as an ordered parts path; resolved logical nodes must be IN,MID,OUT. If parts-path resolution differs, stop before analysis and use confirmed node-name mapping; do not guess PathType enum values.
concrete_parameter_candidates.unit_rule: Set strings use the parameter unit; GetValue is documented MKS for united parameters. Never infer that raw value 100 means 100 Hz. SetValue was used in older scripts but display-unit Set plus MKS readback is the more directly documented control here.

raw_capture: Data plus every rank length and lower bound, enumerated values and indexed elements
linear.secondary_export: Invoke documented dataset.ExportS(new absolute .s2p path); inspect actual format/reference headers and compare all four complex entries to raw aliases. Keep ZPORT raw export because an S file need not preserve every internal metadata field.
linear.known_prior_shape: Archived one-port control had F Data dimensions [1], S [2,1,1], ZPORT [2,1], XML Array_Cplx64. This does not prove the full two-port axis/complex packing.
linear.packing_gate: Do not reuse 1-D Vn interleaved decoding for multidimensional S. Resolve via named aliases plus ExportS and indexed shape capture; if still ambiguous, a dedicated no-analysis asymmetric complex marker variable is an optional marshalling preflight, not the symmetric RES oracle.

RF_path.object_path_pattern: Discover actual new dataset and its path dataset children/siblings by enumeration; do not assume the former System1/System3 suffix. Under Eqns/VarBlock request DCP, DCV, CF and any NODE/PART label independent variables.
required_context: source/analysis setting readbacks and dataset timestamp
RF_path.DCP: GetValue is evaluated in W where a united parameter/variable exposes it; retain raw Data and Unit ID. Never apply dBm conversion to an already-MKS number merely because display Unit is dBm.
RF_path.DCV: Use the documented DCV identity as peak desired voltage, and GetValue linear V only after metadata confirms it. Apply the plan peak oracle directly; do not divide by sqrt(2) based on array shape or a Vn name.
RF_path.Vn_spectra: Existing 1-D Vn/Zn captures are interleaved and older amplifier tools cross-check P=|Vpeak|^2/(2*Re Z) for real 50-ohm cases. That scoped evidence does not define all node-direction, complex-reference or integrated-noise semantics.
RF_path.do_not_reuse: Do not run compare-attenuator.py or compare-amplifier-terms.py as the new comparator; their identities, tolerances, path cardinalities and fixed model assumptions differ.

exports.optional_python_reader: Official external Dataset.export_data(...,"json",options), variables[name].units and value could independently read saved datasets with Python 3.10.x. Its matrix limitations and wrapper support must be preflighted; no import/open/read operation was attempted here.
